entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajnish Sahai Saxena,Ram Bahadur
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.
At the very outset, the attention of the Court was drawn to the fact that a compliance affidavit has been filed by the State in compliance of the order of this Court passed on 07.12.2023.
The I.O. of this case did not submit his report despite several orders of this Court and that is why personal appearance of I.O. was directed by this Court.

2. The State Counsel has submitted that the present I.O., namely, S.I., Ram Awadh Prasad has taken over the charge of investigation on 08.12.2023 and the earlier I.O., S.I., Sarvesh Kumar had been on leave since 26.11.2023 and after coming back, he was transferred to another police station and that is why he could not sent the compliance report to this Court.

It is further submitted that during the period of last two orders passed by this Court, the statement of the victim under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. were recorded and the matter was converted into Sections 363, 120-B, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 POCSO Act and that is why, there was no occasion for the I.O. to issue a notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. to the applicants.

It is next submitted that keeping in view the seriousness of Sanjeet Jaiswal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62258310/
1 the offence and alteration of the matter into some serious sections of law and the POCSO Act, the applicant no.1 was arrested by the police during investigation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. The explanation offered by way of compliance affidavit by the learned State Counsel seems to be satisfactory but the Court expects the police to be more vigilant in making compliance of the orders of this Court.
4. In view of that, notice sent to present I.O., S.I., Ram Awadh Prasad is discharged and his personal appearance is exempted till further orders.

5. The applicants nos.2 & 3 have submitted that since the matter has been altered, the present anticipatory bail application has become infructuous and they should be directed to withdraw the same with liberty to file fresh anticipatory bail application in accordance with law.
7. No need to proceed further in the matter.
8. The present anticipatory bail application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a fresh anticipatory bail application in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 18.12.2023 Shivangi  Sanjeet Jaiswal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62258310/
